text:
sqlpipe moves rows from Postgres to S3 as Parquet objects. Three processes run in a pipeline and pass batches through a bounded queue.

The reader opens a cursor on the source database. It fetches rows in fixed-size batches and puts each batch on the queue.

The converter takes a batch from the queue. It maps each Postgres type to a Parquet type and writes the batch as one Parquet row group. The converter groups row groups into a Parquet file of a target size.

The uploader sends each finished file to S3 as a multipart object. It retries a failed part with an exponential backoff. After the last part, the uploader completes the multipart upload and records the object key.

The queue applies backpressure when a downstream process is slow.
